analysis:
On 4 August 2026 Labour and Employment Minister Mansukh Mandaviya presented figures to NDA MPs stating that more than 17 crore jobs were created between 2014 and 2024, citing Reserve Bank of India data.

A PIB press note gives a Ministry of Labour and Employment estimate that employment rose to 64.33 crore in 2023-24 from 47.5 crore in 2017-18, a net addition of 16.83 crore over six years, a different time frame from the Minister's statement.

The figures are modelled estimates derived from the RBI KLEMS database and Periodic Labour Force Survey data rather than a count of new jobs, and include self-employment and unpaid family labour. Analysts have disputed both the methodology and the magnitude. Because the headline number cannot be reproduced as a direct count and the time frame differs between the statement and the official note, the claim is recorded as misleading.
